context: Couple debriefs after a cast wrap party
purpose: Teach: 演劇/女優/主演/演じ/フィルム/台詞/パーティー/エピソード

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: やっと打ち上げパーティーが終わったね。あなたの主演、本当に素敵だった。
lines.en: The wrap party is finally over. Your lead role was truly wonderful.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate tone with soft admiration, slightly tired but glowing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとう。大学の演劇サークルでこんな大役を演じられるとは思わなかったよ。
lines.en: Thanks. I never imagined I'd play such a big role in a uni theater circle.
lines.style: Modest, reflective young man's voice with genuine surprise and gratitude.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 相手役の女優さん、すごく上手だったよね。台詞の間の取り方が絶妙で。
lines.en: Your co-star actress was incredibly skilled. Her timing between lines was exquisite.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appreciative female voice analyzing craft with quiet enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、彼女のおかげで助かった。実は本番中に台詞をひとつ飛ばしちゃってさ。
lines.en: Yeah, she really saved me. Actually, I skipped one of my lines during the show.
lines.style: Sheepish confession, lowered voice, embarrassed laugh in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えっ、全然気づかなかった!それ、面白いエピソードだから後で話してよ。
lines.en: What, I didn't notice at all! That's a great story, tell me about it later.
lines.style: Surprised, playful exclamation followed by curious giggling teasing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 監督が古いフィルムカメラで舞台裏を撮ってたの、見た?なんか映画みたいだった。
lines.en: Did you see the director filming backstage with an old film camera? Felt cinematic.
lines.style: Animated, slightly excited recollection, sharing a small wonder with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 見た見た。あなた、これからも演劇を続けるんでしょ?私、ずっと応援するから。
lines.en: I saw, I saw. You'll keep doing theater, right? I'll always cheer you on.
lines.style: Tender, supportive promise, warmth deepening into quiet devotion.
